sites.title: creates an opaque UUID attempt id
sites.evidence: Opaque UUID format survives into real attempt row primary key; a constant/non-UUID identifier from createScanResolveAttemptId fails the regex. Route fixtures replace ID generation, so they cannot prove this.

sites.title: records a started attempt with canonical value
sites.evidence: Exact started insert table and complete id/user/type/raw/canonical projection; catches wrong table, raw/canonical confusion or added timestamp. Primary keeper for D1.

sites.title: completes exactly the same unfinished attempt with the v2 terminal outcome
sites.evidence: Actual completion update values, timestamp type, exact id and completed_at=null filters; catches overwrite of completed row or wrong attempt. This observes SDK query construction, not a true concurrent DB race.

sites.title: persists dm lookup telemetry only when the completed resolve was eligible
sites.evidence: Actual dm payload projection hit/420/1500 is observed on completion; catches omitted or swapped duration/deadline fields. Title overstates eligibility: route owns deciding eligible; no negative eligibility input here.

sites.title: non-GTIN raw value logs a null canonical value
sites.evidence: Actual invalid GTIN1234 produces canonical_value=null on inserted row; catches fallback storing invalid raw value as canonical. Different actual canonicalizer branch from valid row keeper.

sites.title: fail-open: an insert error never throws
sites.evidence: Resolved insert error must not reject the scan telemetry writer. Keeper: tests/scan-resolve-route.test.ts :: attempt telemetry: an attempt-log write failure reaches Sentry through the route's injected captureScanException; recordScanResolveAttempt writes payload then branches solely on response.error; reportAttemptLogFailure reads Date.now/throttle and error message, never GTIN/ids/createdAt. Real route drains actual writer through queued scheduleAttemptWrite FIFO.

sites.title: fail-open: a thrown client error never propagates
sites.evidence: Async client insert rejection network down takes writer catch path, unlike resolved error object in C1/C2; removing catch makes doesNotReject fail. It is not a synchronous from() throw test.

sites.title: fail-open: a completion error never propagates
sites.evidence: Resolved completion update error does not reject. Keeper: tests/scan-resolve-event-log.test.ts :: a completion-write failure also captures to Sentry; completeScanResolveAttempt constructs update then error/capture path; same calls and data, independent actual completion owner remains.

sites.title: an explicit createdAt is written as the row's created_at
sites.evidence: Supplied request timestamp survives exactly as created_at despite deferred insert; catches dropping the override and using DB drain-time default. Default omission keeper cannot prove positive timestamp.

sites.title: without an explicit createdAt the row keeps the column default
sites.evidence: Without createdAt property, inserted row must omit created_at so DB default remains. Keeper: tests/scan-resolve-event-log.test.ts :: records a started attempt with canonical value; Same record writer createdAt false branch. Keeper checks entire row own-enumerable keys exactly and correct scan_resolve_events table.

sites.title: a start-write failure captures once to Sentry with the attempt_log_write_failed reason
sites.evidence: Exactly one warning capture with route resolve,status200,reason attempt_log_write_failed. Keeper: tests/scan-resolve-route.test.ts :: attempt telemetry: an attempt-log write failure reaches Sentry through the route's injected captureScanException; Neither reportAttemptLogFailure nor capture details depend on attempt payload fields; differences in valid GTIN/ids/timestamp do not distinguish this failure branch.

sites.title: a completion-write failure also captures to Sentry
sites.evidence: Real completion error invokes capture once and (after transfer) does not reject. Start-insert route keeper cannot cover update-chain error branch. Removing completion reportAttemptLogFailure fails count.

sites.title: a second write failure within the 60s throttle window does not capture again
sites.evidence: Two failed writes in same unchanged real-clock window produce only one capture; removing now<throttleUntil guard emits2. First capture and suppression observed independently.

sites.title: a write failure after the throttle window resets captures again
sites.evidence: Claims expiry but calls resetAttemptLogCaptureThrottleForTests between writes, so changing throttle duration to Infinity still passes. Retain expiry contract; repair in place using controlled Date.now and existing two writes at exact+60000ms, no second reset. Keep separate within-window case. No F repair included in proposed cuts.

sites.title: adds nullable v2 terminal telemetry without changing the legacy outcome contract
sites.evidence: Enum/storage compatibility remains independently static: lookup4,terminal8,failure-stage10 values, nullable legacy outcome preserved and new fields/default present. Runtime replay has no complete enum input matrix/catalog read, so cannot absorb whole declaration under no-new-input rules.

sites.title: backfills every legacy event as terminal-unknown, never as a proven resolution
sites.evidence: Every existing legacy row backfills telemetry_version1 and legacy_unknown, never proven resolved. Keeper: tests/scan-resolve-events-migration.test.ts :: telemetry migration executes, accepts v2 starts, and aggregates before retention deletion; UPDATE guards only telemetry_version IS NULL and terminal_outcome IS NULL, not outcome. All10 satisfy both. Keeper later inserts real v2 row and reapplies migration preserving version2+null.

sites.title: materializes only non-PII aggregates before raw data deletion and remains idempotent
sites.evidence: Aggregate field inventory, PII-column exclusion, exact conflict key and aggregate-before-delete contract. Runtime keeper only checks summed count, not all columns/privacy/order after interruption. Retain cheapest independent SQL schema/privacy proof.

sites.title: keeps telemetry service-role-only, with bounded UTC retention and a stable daily cron job
sites.evidence: Role grants/revocations, SECURITY INVOKER/search_path, shared-schema grant preservation, UTC cutoff,12-month aggregate retention and stable03:15 cron. Runtime covers function privileges only; cron function is fixture-defined, no actual pg_cron scheduler or UTC-boundary case. Cannot cut whole static declaration.

sites.title: telemetry migration executes, accepts v2 starts, and aggregates before retention deletion
sites.evidence: Actual expansion SQL migrates10 legacy rows, supports null-start v2, reapplies without corrupting inflight, preserves schema/function grants, executes retention twice and checks raw1/aggregate10. Primary D2 keeper. Removing backfill or deleting raw first fails actual database output.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: a premium in-catalog resolve auto-saves exactly this product
sites.evidence: Actual route schedules correct admin client/user/product only after response. Moving write inline fails empty calls; wrong identity/client fails captured callback. Distinct successful dispatch observation from write-failure keeper.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: the response reflects the predicted post-save state, not the stale pre-save read (F3)
sites.evidence: Premium null pre-save state responds200 with savedState merkliste/managedByScan true before deferred write. Keeper: tests/scan-resolve-auto-save.test.ts :: scan resolve auto-save: a write failure is caught and reported, never turned into a 5xx; afterQueue stores callback until flush. Actual route computes responseSavedState when prior.state===null before any save invocation. Keeper asserts status200,kind in_catalog,exact savedState before flush, then exact failure capture.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: an already-saved product's response state is carried through unchanged
sites.evidence: Existing merkliste/true preserved; changing branch to downgrade already-saved state fails exact body. Null prediction keeper cannot observe positive-existing state.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: an owned (routine) product's response state is carried through unchanged (F2)
sites.evidence: Existing routine/false must not become merkliste/true; unconditional optimistic assignment violates exclusivity and fails exact body.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: a masked (free-tier) resolve never auto-saves — direct-request denial
sites.evidence: Masked response and freeRevealAvailable are meaningful, but forbidden autoSave throws are swallowed in actual inner catch; flushing alone does not prove absence. Replace throwing-only sentinel with invocation counter checked after same flush, or observe queue admission. No change included.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: flag off never auto-saves, even for an otherwise-premium user
sites.evidence: Flag-off response and no entitlement read are meaningful (entitlement throw would503), but base after() discards callbacks so forbidden deferred auto-save stays invisible. In-place counter on scheduler/callback with real captured drain needed. No new request required; held unchanged.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: a not_needed verdict never auto-saves (nothing in-catalog to save)
sites.evidence: not_needed response and no paid-access lookup are meaningful, but discarding after callback hides forbidden deferred write. Keep this verdict branch; repair scheduler admission observation in place. Held unchanged.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: an unavailable paid-access lookup still fails closed with 503, before any save
sites.evidence: Unavailable access503 independently meaningful, but no deferred queue observation proves before-any-save; a scheduled write followed by access throw would still503. Retain with future queue/counter repair, no deletion.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: a write failure is caught and reported, never turned into a 5xx
sites.evidence: Optimistic null→merkliste body is asserted BEFORE actual deferred failure, then exact warning tuple after flush. Rethrowing deferred save fails flush; deleting/reporting wrong reason fails capture. Primary D3 keeper.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: a synchronously throwing after() cannot turn a resolved scan into a 503
sites.evidence: ProductId route reaches auto-save-specific runAfter try/catch; synchronously thrown scheduler must still return200. Barcode telemetry scheduler has separate catch so its sibling is not equivalent.

sites.title: scan resolve auto-save: rescanning the same product auto-saves again each time (idempotency is the DB's job, not a client-side skip)
sites.evidence: Two actual requests both enqueue a save and drain invokes twice; a handler-local cached already-saved skip fails count2. DB idempotency tests do not prove route attempts each request.

sites.title: auto-save: a bare scan wishlist-saves the product (round trip into the listing the Gemerkt section reads)
sites.evidence: Actual owner and SQL persist one wishlist row after FIRST call on empty fixture. Title overstates listing roundtrip (only table count is read), but real first-write contract remains. Repeated final state does not observe this exact intermediate; held rather than add query/input.

sites.title: auto-save: rescanning the same product is idempotent — exactly one row survives repeated scans
sites.evidence: Actual owner called3 times against same SQL store, unique row survives. Deleting/widening UNIQUE conflict target causes PostgreSQL error or wrong count. Shim hardcodes DO NOTHING and ignores ignoreDuplicates; independent retained saved-state:222 asserts actual SDK option; do not claim full Supabase transport parity.

sites.title: auto-save NON-DESTRUCTIVE REGRESSION: owning a product, then rescanning + auto-saving it, leaves the ownership row untouched AND writes no wishlist row (F2)
sites.evidence: After exactly one owned rescan, same projected id/status/identity/source row and zero wishlist; before.length1 and owned/catalog_search literals guard fixture and non-destruction. Repeated keeper lacks first-call observation and fixed-literal guards; union not established without extra read.

sites.title: auto-save NON-DESTRUCTIVE REGRESSION: repeated rescan+auto-save of an owned product never touches ownership nor writes a wishlist row, across multiple scans
sites.evidence: After3 rescans of owned row, projected owned row persists and zero wishlist. Existing first-rescan keeper does not observe repeated invocation lifecycle; possible ownership fast-path/cache state change affects repeats. No claim distinct raw input alone is sufficient; current repeated boundary preserved conservatively.

sites.title: auto-save: scoped to user and product — another user's or another product's rows are untouched
sites.evidence: Three actual user/product keys each produce row; total3 rejects broad conflict target or lost user/product scope. Do not cut as duplicate bare save: multi-key isolation is independent.

sites.title: auto-save: an owned row from ANOTHER user does not block this user's rescan, and is itself untouched
sites.evidence: Other-user ownership must not suppress this user insert nor touch foreign row/wishlist; removing user_id ownership filter would skip wrongly and fail current-user count.

sites.title: scan wishlist GET: unauthenticated is rejected
sites.evidence: Actual wishlist route with null auth returns401 before handler; removing auth gate returns200. Other scan routes use wrapper but do not prove this configured route still composes it.

sites.title: scan wishlist GET: rate limited returns 429 with Retry-After, before any load
sites.evidence: Denied limiter returns429/rate_limited and bounded Retry-After before list call; bypass limiter produces503 from forbidden-list sentinel, so negative is meaningful here.

sites.title: scan wishlist GET: rate limiter unavailable fails closed with 503, without a Sentry capture
sites.evidence: Unavailable limiter returns503/temporarily_unavailable without capture; treating outage as429 or routing through exception capture fails independently.

sites.title: scan wishlist GET: returns the injected entries
sites.evidence: Actual route delivers {entries:[entry]} HTTP200; stub supplies model data but actual owner must envelope/serialize it. Dropped/wrong response key fails; not fixture-only comparison.

sites.title: scan wishlist GET: an unexpected error maps to 503 and captures to Sentry
sites.evidence: Actual list throw boom becomes503 and exact error identity plus route/reason/user capture; removing capture or using wrong context fails.

sites.title: listScanWishlist: joins product fields and presents commerce data
sites.evidence: Actual listing forwards user filter, descending created_at order and joined fields into independent commerce mapper. Wrong filter/order/projection fails. Intl expected formatter does not execute helper under test but this is not full SDK join proof.

sites.title: listScanWishlist: drops a row whose joined product is gone (deleted/deactivated)
sites.evidence: Null joined product filters toempty rather than dereference or leak entry; valid lifecycle/quarantine cases cannot take missing-join branch.

sites.title: listScanWishlist: a load error throws a stable error
sites.evidence: Resolved DB read error converts to stable scan_wishlist_list_failed; ignoring error yields[] and rejects assertion fails.

sites.title: listScanWishlist: drops a product that has since been deactivated or discontinued
sites.evidence: Mixed active/inactive/discontinued products yield onlyprod-1; dropping either lifecycle conjunct leaks corresponding row. Actual predicate, not mock filter, owns decision.

sites.title: listScanWishlist: drops a disposition-quarantined product (ruling R7)
sites.evidence: Real loadQuarantinedProductIdsAmong executes against returned disposition row; actual listing removes only quarantined ID. Disabling membership filter leaks2. Stub does not implement filter policy.
